content:wysiwyg_basic:11:56:9:25.html:
Please click the links below to view ways to engage and give back.

The Salvation Army is unable to accommodate court ordered and lawyer suggested community service requests.

Center of Hope Meal Service: Providing nourishment and comfort to individuals and families experiencing homelessness.

Adopt a Meal Program: This program provides a much-needed meal to the women and children at our Center of Hope Homeless Shelter. Organizations, church groups, corporate teams, and individuals are needed to provide meals for the families staying with us. 

Group Opportunities: We can accommodate your group’s desire to do something good together – whether family, friends, coworkers, civic or church groups. 

Other Group and Individual Volunteer Opportunities:

  • Acceptable Donations for the Center of Hope
  • Welcome Home Baskets
  • Dignity Drive for new underwear
  • Hope Bundles
  • Linen and Bedding Drive
  • Snack Pack Program
  • Teen Project Instructions
